findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 揭露公司受進出口、國際貿易限制、反壟斷等多項法規約束，且曾／可能面臨調查與法規程序，屬一般性風險因子，未點名具體反壟斷案件。
findings.excerpt: The company has in the past and may in the future be subject to claims, investigations, regulatory proceedings, and lawsuits in and outside the ordinary course of business

findings.claim: 2025-10 美國 BIS 曾將 Arrow 三家中國子公司列入實體清單，其後據報導已撤銷；屬出口管制而非反壟斷。
findings.source: 搜尋摘要：Arrow Electronics says that US trade curbs on its Chinese affiliates are being reversed

findings.claim: 搜尋未發現 2026 年針對 Arrow 的 DOJ／FTC／歐盟反壟斷調查或拆分事件；舊有 2014 FTC CID（資料庫共享計畫）僅見於 2014–2017 年舊申報。
findings.excerpt: no proceedings have been instituted against any person

note: 2026 無反壟斷／拆分事件查獲；實體清單為出口管制事項。
